items.name: Canada's Best in the West 2024

venue.name: [Roundhouse Community Arts & Recreation Centre](https://www.roundhouse.ca/facilities-rentals/exhibition-hall/)
venue.details: The competition will be held in the Exhibition Hall on the first floor

items.information:
This is the follow-up to [Canada's Best in the West 2018](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CanadasBestInTheWest2018) in Alberta. We're excited to bring the next edition to BC!

**Please review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You only need to show up for the events that you're competing in - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, so please be ready for each event/round **about 30 minutes in advance**, just in case.

To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Unsubscribe at any time.

**Notice of filming and photography**: Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

Masks will be optional. Do not attend if you feel/are sick.

items.name: Leersum Algs 2024
items.information:
Dit is een tweedaagse wedstrijd, open voor alle deelnemers. Gasten zijn welkom.

This is a two day competition, open to all competitors. Guests are welcome.

items.name: Baton Rouge Winter 2024
items.information:
This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/).

Make sure to check out [Louisiana Speedcubing's Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1025679060833637) for upcoming competitions and announcements!

To learn more about Cubing in the US South, including other competitions, visit www.southerncubing.com.

- Please review the [competitor information] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BatonRougeWinter2024#35056-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BatonRougeWinter2024#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule
